_doc: Physics layer of SpellProgram: what each channel does to the world's properties per unit of channel power. Engines with a material/simulation system should consume `fields` and let materials decide consequences (wood ignites when heat exceeds its threshold, ice melts, a golem cracks when solidity drops). The `ops` verbs are the convenience layer derived from the same spell.

properties.moisture: wetness, water amount; extinguishes, conducts, grows
properties.motion: kinetic push/pressure along the delivery direction
properties.solidity: structure, hardness, mass; walls, armour, cracking
properties.vitality: life force of living things; positive heals, negative harms
properties.will: mental state: focus, calm, fear, perception
properties.timeflow: local rate of time; <0 slows, >0 hastens
